summary: Frontend-only verification of SAURABH Master Chart (dark + sakura editions). All requested features validated: 9 real planetary rows with exact degree strings, Neecha Bhanga & Lord of 1st & 10th tags, absence of placeholder text, Page 2 with natal SVG wheel + monogram seal + dedication + script signature, updated House Architecture (Vessel/Forge/Powerhouse/Arena) and INTUITIVE ARCHITECT callout, all 4 toolbar controls with correct data-testids on both editions. Root redirect to /master-chart.html works. All 4 PDFs (A4 + Letter, dark + sakura) return HTTP 200 application/pdf with sizes 270-293 KB. 46/46 DOM checks passed per edition.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static-only site. Verified via Playwright DOM inner_text scanning for degree strings and via curl -I for PDFs. Both editions expose identical toolbar testids: download-pdf-btn, download-letter-btn, print-pdf-btn, and cross-link (sakura-edition-link on dark; dark-edition-link on sakura).
